pull.title: test: Add missing test case for getdata requests from blocks-only peers
pull.body: ProcessGetData starts by eagerly processing getdata requests. In this loop, a special case checks for peers that have not requested transaction announcements (ie blocksonly) and ignores those requests.  This test prevents regressions for that special case, which is currently not covered by existing tests.
